mapper.sql: id, system_code, system_name, business_code, business_name, order_id, scene_code, scene_name, contract_code, contract_name, client_code, client_name, org_id, org_name, business_date, finance_date, client_type, interface_data, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, del_flag, ebank_serial_number, bank_org_id, ebank_batch_no, is_extract_data, voucher_date
mapper.select:
select ec.financial_contract_status as financialContractStatus, coalesce(ecb.receivable_rent_amount,0) as receivableLeaseAmount, coalesce(ecb.receivable_residual_value_amount,0) as receivableLastAmount, coalesce(ecb.receivable_outtax_amount,0) as receivableLastAmountd, coalesce(ecb.receivable_downpayment_amount,0) as receivableFirstAmount, coalesce(ecb.receivable_insurance_amount,0) as receivableInsuranceAmount, coalesce(ecb.receivable_commission_amount,0) as receivableProcedureAmount, coalesce(ecb.receivable_otherincome_amount,0) as receiveOtherRevenues, coalesce(ecb.unrealized_revenue_amount,0) as receiveOtherRevenuesd, coalesce(ecb.receivable_default_interest_amount,0) as recycleDefaultInterestAmount, coalesce(ecb.receivable_terminate_amount,0) as receiveTerminateProcedureAmount, coalesce(ecb.lessee_margin_amount,0) as receivableMarginAmount, coalesce(ecb.lease_revenue_balance,0) as leaseRevenueAmount, coalesce(ecb.receivable_outtax_balance,0) as receivableOuttaxAmount, coalesce(ecb.depreciation_loss_reverse_amount,0) as depreciationLossAmount, (coalesce(ecb.depreciation_reserves_balance,0) + coalesce(ecb.depreciation_loss_reverse_amount,0)) as depreciationReservesAmount, coalesce(ecb.depreciation_reserves_balance,0) as depreciationAmount from eg_voucher ev inner join eg_contract_balance ecb on ev.id = ecb.voucher_id inner join eg_contract ec on ecb.contract_code = ec.contract_code where 1 = 1 and ev.del_flag ='0' and ecb.del_flag ='0' and ev.sub_scene_type = '25'
and ev.interface_data_id = #{condition.interfaceDataId}

select
from eg_interface_data i where ebank_batch_no is not null and del_flag = '0' and (is_extract_data = '0' or is_extract_data is null) and ((coalesce(interface_data->>'receiveTA','') <> interface_data->>'receiveUnconfirmed' and interface_data->>'receiveUnconfirmed' <>'0') or (interface_data->>'payableReceivableUnconfirmReceipt'<>'0') or (interface_data->>'payableOverdeposit'<>'0') or (interface_data->>'receivableUnconfirm'<>'0')) and voucher_date is not null and (org_id in ('01-C0001','02-C0001','80001','30001') OR bank_org_id in ('01-C0001','02-C0001','80001','30001'))

select eid.id, eid.system_code, eid.system_name, eid.business_code, eid.business_name, eid.order_id, eid.scene_code, eid.scene_name, eid.contract_code, eid.contract_name, eid.client_code, eid.client_name, eid.org_id, eid.org_name, eid.business_date, eid.finance_date, eid.client_type, eid.interface_data, eid.create_by, eid.create_time, eid.update_by, eid.update_time, eid.del_flag, eid.ebank_serial_number, eid.bank_org_id, eid.ebank_batch_no, eid.is_extract_data, eid.voucher_date from eg_interface_data eid inner join eg_raw_transaction_data raw on eid.interface_id = raw.id where raw.message_status = 'SUCCESS' and eid.scene_code ='HTQZ' and eid.business_date < #{params.endDate} and eid.business_date >= '2025-11-01'
and eid.del_flag = '0' and eid.contract_code not like 'CS%' and eid.contract_code not in ( select distinct contract_code from eg_repayment_plan where del_flag = '0' ) and eid.contract_code in (select contract_code from eg_repayment_plan_pl union select contract_code from eg_repayment_plan_xw union select contract_code from eg_repayment_plan_hy )

select eid.org_id , eoc.org_name, eid.business_date , eid.system_code , eid.scene_name , eid.contract_code , eid.client_code , ec.client_name , eid.interface_id, eid.id from eg_interface_data eid left join eg_org_company eoc on eid.org_id = eoc.org_id and eoc.del_flag ='0' left join eg_client ec on ec.client_code = eid.client_code and ec.del_flag ='0' where eid.del_flag = '0' and (payable_number = #{param.paymentIdentifier} or payment_order = #{param.paymentIdentifier})
